Text:
Weconomix team gets into the weeds of the Budi Madani RON95 targeted subsidy distribution that aims to eliminate access to the subsidy for non-Malaysians. The program allocates 300L per Malaysian who has their Identity Card and valid Malaysian Driver’s License and is aged 16 and above. WE discuss what the 300 Litre means for Malaysian’s–from, whether 300L  per-month is enough, how it will affect our petrol pumping culture, the savings it will provide to the National budget to what we can look forward to from money earned not spending on blanket RON95 subsidy.
